name: University of Waterloo
summary: Opened in 1957 with co-op at its core: 77% of students do it, with 8,000+ employers; six faculties on a 1,000-acre campus in Waterloo.

ib.text: IB Diploma with six courses, three at HL; totals exclude diploma points. Totals run from 27 (Arts) to 32 (Computer Science); HL Analysis & Approaches 6 for Computer Science and Mathematics.

dates.label: Application deadline, programs other than Engineering
Documents and Admission Information Form due, programs other than Engineering
Engineering: documents, supplementary forms and online interview due

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Learn how software is designed and built, with more than 70 courses from AI and data science to cybersecurity. No programming background is assumed, and co-op can add up to two years of paid work.
programmes.ib: HL Maths AA with a 6 and English A are required, with a total of 32 (diploma points excluded); the Admission Information Form is required.

needs.note: HL English B with a 5 is also accepted

programmes.selectionNote: Predicted IB total plus the Admission Information Form on your interests and experience. Apply early; programs fill, and 32 is the floor, not a guarantee.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science at Waterloo: 70+ courses, co-op available, in the Faculty of Mathematics

programmes.name: Software Engineering
programmes.about: An engineering degree in software design, algorithms, digital hardware and human-computer interfaces, offered with the Faculty of Mathematics. It is co-op only, alternating study with paid work terms.
programmes.ib: Maths AA, Physics, Chemistry and English A at 4+, one more course at 4+, total 31. Admission Information Form, online interview and programming experience required.

needs.note: HL English B with a 5 is also accepted

programmes.selectionNote: Selected individually: predicted IB total, the Admission Information Form and a required online software engineering interview. 6s and 7s are recommended.

flagshipSource.title: Software Engineering at Waterloo: co-op only, in a region with more than 1,500 technology companies

faculties.name: Faculty of Mathematics
faculties.line: HL Maths AA with a 6 and English A, total 30; every program needs the Admission Information Form.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: Maths, Physics, Chemistry and English at 4+, total about 31; AIF and an online interview are required; earlier deadline.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Maths AA at 4+, English and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics; totals around 27 for physical sciences.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health
faculties.line: Kinesiology: Maths and two lab sciences at 4+, English at 4+, total 27.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: Honours Arts and Business: English A at 4 or HL English B at 5, total 27; no other subject required.

notes: Computer Science and every Mathematics and Engineering program need the Admission Information Form; Engineering also needs an online interview.
Waterloo admits first-year students for September only, and international applicants have the same deadlines as everyone else.
Tuition figures are Waterloo's estimates of tuition and incidental fees for two terms (eight months, full course load) for students starting September 2026.
